review_type: Independent v2 design-only delta and arithmetic review
scope: Read only v2 design documents and freeze; checked v1 frozen documents and original independent review hashes. Ran stdlib-only JSON/hash/integer arithmetic checks on these documents. No model, dataset, samples, raw source, TRAIN, selection, final or private_manager read; no model imports, inference, training, synthetic model execution or network writes.

prior_findings_disposition.finding: Mandatory L linear baseline restores the prior requirement. It uses identical schedules, loss, corruption and seed set, but has smaller capacity and distinct initialization shape. L is descriptive, not selected or used for additional inferential claims. Selection thresholds explicitly apply only to A/B/C, while missing/nonfinite L execution still prevents complete four-arm reporting.

prior_findings_disposition.disposition: Resolved as a preregistered local diagnostic with restricted interpretation
prior_findings_disposition.finding: A/B now each receive exactly 16 uniform and 16 cyclic probability interventions at the final Q checkpoint, using previously fixed probes and no labels. Same h and weights are required; full encoder work is charged. B byte identity is mandatory. A detection threshold is fixed at strictly greater than 1e-7; no detection is reported without retries, tuning or extra probes. This satisfies the requirement to preregister an actual output intervention, but successful detection remains unobserved and is not guaranteed.
prior_findings_disposition.claim_boundary: A/B tests enabling the connection during both training and inference. The intervention does not separate gradient-mediated learning from inference effects, identify semantic class information, prove denoising benefit or demonstrate sensitivity of the later T checkpoints. Those limitations are expressly disclosed. No detected Q sensitivity must never be summarized as demonstrated conditioning use.

prior_findings_disposition.disposition: Resolved as scope separation, not budget approval
prior_findings_disposition.finding: Next possible admission is explicitly source implementation plus separately frozen finite synthetic qualification only. All TRAIN export/Q/T/S/F allowances remain unapproved. The revised 2,860-second worker-limit sum is clearly a new proposal, not executed cost, historical-cap continuation, strict256 exception or aggregate runtime guarantee.

prior_findings_disposition.disposition: Execution prerequisite retained; not a blocker to completing a design-only deliverable
prior_findings_disposition.finding: Source, runtime and fixtures are intentionally future artifacts. No implementation feasibility or resource-enforcement guarantee is made. The design may be accepted as complete within this documentary scope without permitting implementation or execution.

prior_findings_disposition.disposition: Resolved at design level, fixture verification still required
prior_findings_disposition.finding: Top52-bit midpoint uniform values are exactly representable binary64 and strictly between zero and one. New v2 key domain and changed streams are recorded before execution. Bootstrap retains unbiased raw64-bit rejection sampling. Group ordering and binary64 metric reduction order are explicit. Initialization operation order and no-FMA rule are given. Remaining numerical/operator implementation details belong in the future source freeze and known-answer fixtures.

scientific_scope: A/B parameter allocation, initialization and stipulated dense operations remain matched, except the intended fixed conditioning mask. B has less useful capacity, explicitly acknowledged. Source/runtime evidence is required to verify actual matching.
C retains 750 more parameters and 740 more forward MACs per example than A/B; it is a competitive control, not a matched causal arm. L is a much smaller mandatory descriptive baseline.
All arms remain static finite functions. No universal static-class superiority or general multimodal capability follows from any result.

The six inferential endpoints remain only A/B and A/C, with paired image-group bootstrap, fixed ranks 82 and 9916, fixed margins and all-seed sign safeguards. L adds no multiplicity claim. Approximate coverage, unknown writer clustering and fixed-training-seed inference remain explicit.

Selection gates do not require favorable A contrasts. Passing Q or S never automatically admits a later phase. Null, negative, saturated, incomplete and infeasible outcomes remain reportable without protocol repair.
future_execution_prerequisites: Obtain explicit narrow implementation/synthetic authorization and freeze its exact finite fixture workload and guards. This review itself authorizes neither.

Independently review exact source/runtime/fixtures, including stable cross-entropy and softmax, all-arm argmax tie behavior, float32 reduction/operator conventions, zero-mask dense operations, Adam reference vectors, PRNG endpoints, singleton serialization and intervention hook behavior. Bind all details before real data access.

Verify thread/descendant restrictions, existing-lock ownership, per-process hard limits, wall/reap behavior, bounded output schema, failed-artifact retention and full wait4 accounting. No normal-success or documentary design proves abnormal-failure behavior.

TRAIN export and each Q/T/S/F phase require their own exact actor, input/output and resource admission. Explicit authority must cover actual work; a complete design is not authority to spend its proposed budgets.

Charge optimizer/nonlinear/PRNG/statistical/import/serialization/hash/review work beyond dense MACs. Retain supervisor tails and unmeasured review/tool cost as unknown, not zero. No guaranteed fit, runtime, power or performance.
review_cost: Document-only review/tool cost not separately measured; unknown additional cost, never included as zero in proposed worker totals.
